note: Decoder measurements preceded release-label finalization; algorithms are the candidate tested here. The existing development corpora are not held out. Reports omit raw decoded text.

developmentRegression.timingScope: Shared-load preservation run; use the sequential paired comparison for release speed claims.

freshOpenCV.method: Original-resolution pixels. Close/monitor annotations transformed from publisher 1024-short-side test coordinates. One-to-one polygon IoU >= 0.10. No expected values provided to decoders.

pairedTiming.selection: First up to two inputs per category in the frozen BoofCV manifest that historically completed without timeout in under 3000 ms. Selected before candidate timing. This is a fast/completed development subset, not whole-corpus speed.
